item.title: Oil trade’s shipping bottleneck threatens a fresh wave of inflation
item.description: The rise in oil prices on world markets is showing no sign of stopping. It is important to understand that a key factor is the risk that oil may not reach buyers on time, while transportation costs continue to rise significantly.
